title: regional-heartbeat-prioritizer-temporal-quarantine
author: Maya Rodriguez
release_notes: Introduces a temporal quarantine and heartbeat-stability prioritizer to reduce region flap and noisy regional failovers. Adds telemetry for quarantine events and SLO impact tracing. Default quarantine enabled for Dedicated clusters; flaggable via runtime feature toggle.
description: Motivation: A production incident (see ENG-3421) showed repeated regional failover flip-flopping when control-plane heartbeats exhibited transient jitter. This resulted in elevated SLO violations and noisy rollbacks. This PR introduces a lightweight prioritizer that factors in a heartbeat stability score and a temporal quarantine window when a regional circuit is tripped so we avoid lockstep re-evictions that amplify instability. Changes: 1) runtime/slo/heartbeat_prioritizer.go: new prioritizer that computes a heartbeat_stability_score (0..100) based on median inter-arrival and variance, and incorporates it into allocation scoring. 2) routing/regional_quarantine.go: temporal quarantine controller that prevents re-eviction for a configurable cooldown period (default 45s) and tracks quarantine origins (manual vs automatic). 3) telemetry/metrics.go: new metrics: redwood.slo.quarantine_initiated_total, redwood.slo.quarantine_duration_seconds, redwood.slo.heartbeat_stability_gauge and a trace span for quarantine decisions. 4) config/feature_flags.yaml: runtime flag "enable_temporal_quarantine" (opt-in for canary clusters, on for Dedicated by default). 5) docs/runbooks/regional-failover.md: update with guidance and CLI commands to inspect and override quarantines. 6) tests: unit tests for prioritizer logic, integration test that simulates jittering heartbeats and asserts no repeated re-eviction within the quarantine window. Checklist: - [x] Design doc & ops runbook updated - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration test added (simulated jitter) - [x] Telemetry dashboards prototyped - [x] Feature flagged for gradual rollout Commits (high-level): - "add heartbeat stability prioritizer and tests" - "implement temporal quarantine controller and CLI hooks" - "add telemetry counters and trace spans" - "enable feature flag and docs" Files changed (high-level): - runtime/slo/heartbeat_prioritizer.go (new) - routing/regional_quarantine.go (new) - telemetry/metrics.go (modified) - config/feature_flags.yaml (modified) - docs/runbooks/regional-failover.md (modified) - tests/integration/jitter_quarantine_test.go (new) - cli/quarantine_inspect.go (small addition) Review convo summary: - Evan Cho: "Nice minimal surface area. Two asks: expose quarantine TTL per-region in admin API and add a unit test for TTL override." Author(Maya): "Added admin endpoint /admin/quarantine/{region}/ttl and unit test; pushed." - Priya Nair: "Concern: could we accidentally hide real capacity problems under quarantine? Suggest adding a quarantine_reason label and a health check that escalates if SLOs keep accumulating during quarantine." Author: "Added quarantine_reason label, wired metric redwood.slo.quarantine_reason_count and added note in runbook to escalate after three consecutive quarantines in 5m." - Luca Moretti: "CI flake observed on integration test under high CPU; recommend retry-and-backoff in test harness." Author: "Test harness updated to use exponential backoff; CI flake addressed." CI: - unit tests: pass - integration tests: pass (after harness fix) - linters: pass - e2e canary: queued during rollout Merge: Merged via squash on 2026-02-03 after approvals from Evan and Priya. Post-merge actions: - Rollout plan: enable on canary Dedicated clusters (internal tag) for 24h, monitor redwood.slo.quarantine_initiated_total and latency p95; if stable, flip flag for all Dedicated and then gradually for Hosted. - Dashboard: added quarantine panel under "SLO Enforcement" dashboard. Operational notes: - Default quarantine TTL is 45s; operator can change via admin API or cluster config. - Quarantine counters are exported to Prometheus with labels (region, reason, origin). - If a region is quarantined 3x within 5m, Alert SRE-119 page and create a P1 investigation. Why this is different from previous mitigations: Instead of only throttling or widening SLO windows, this approach uses a short, observable quarantine period coupled with a heartbeat stability score so we avoid both noisy re-eviction cascades and hiding persistent capacity issues. This is intentionally conservative: short TTLs, opt-in flag, and clear escalation paths.
notes: hotfix targeted at production regional instability
